title: Which g v2 change costs accuracy: ablation of the symmetric inputs, the smooth-abs EPS and the gm/gds penalty on the 18-fold LODO, and a training-data-only nested selection of lambda in {0, 1, 2, 5, 10} V; sky130 77 K, 18 devices, state C
done_before: none of the I15-2 runs (stored I13-1 rows and corrections only)

recipe.net: 3-16-16-1 tanh, zero-init last layer, OUT_SCALE tanh output

heldout_refit.metric: strict paper RRMS, frozen curve inclusion

contrast_labels.change_named_costly: at least one of its contrasts labelled cost

selection.inner_folds: training devices sorted by (polarity nMOS first, tag); i-th -> fold i mod 3
selection.inner_model: one member, seed 0, recipe above, trained on the training devices outside the inner fold (load order), penalty grids of those devices
selection.inner_heldout: refit of each inner held-out device's card with the member in the loop (recipe above), strict paper RRMS
selection.score: mean over inner held-out devices of ln RRMS; non-finite RRMS counts as ln(1.0)
selection.choice: argmin score; ties within 1e-12 -> larger lambda
selection.scope: 18 outer folds (17 training devices) + full-data model (18 devices, reported, not scored)
selection.selected_row: held-out row of the 5-seed LODO variant sym_e1_l{lambda*_h} for fold h

secondary: per-variant table (all-device, combined, median, GMR vs v1 and C0_refit, devices lower, failed)

negative_fractions.grid: penalty grids (card forward current > 1 nA), dg/du central differences h 1e-5 V (penalty_value_numpy)
sets: held-out starting-card grid (mean over folds and pooled)
negative_fractions.variants: every variant incl. v1, sym_e1_l10 and selected

outcome.invalid: any validity fail -> stop: fix and re-register

validity.V1: seed 0 of fold pmos_L2_W5 reproduces stored member 0: (a) sym_e1_l10 vs I13_1/lodo M_bias_v2|pmos_L2_W5, (b) abs lambda 0 vs I13_1/all18 M_bias|pmos_L2_W5; max |weight diff| = 0
validity.V2: held-out refit of stored g v2 fold corrections of nmos_L1_W1p6 and pmos_L2_W5 reproduces stored rows; max |RRMS diff| <= 1e-9
validity.V3: 18 held-out rows per new variant; inner CV complete (19 x 5 x 3 trainings; every inner held-out device scored)

order: prereg commit (alone) -> code + unit tests commit -> smoke (2 outer folds, 200 steps, refit max_nfev 20) -> queue (one heavy job at a time, 6 workers): I15_2_validity, I15_2_lodo_sym_e0_l0, _sym_e1_l0, _sym_e0_l10, _sym_e1_l1, _sym_e1_l2, _sym_e1_l5, I15_2_inner, I15_2_decide
